United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

description.narrative: Following the devastating 2025 monsoon floods in Swat District, UNESCO Pakistan Office has launched a Rapid Education Damage and Climate Resilience Assessment covering approximately 120 girls’ schools across Bahrain, Charbagh, Khwazakhela, and Matta tehsils, focusing on infrastructure, WASH, learning continuity, psychosocial needs, and resilience gaps. Preliminary findings indicate extensive losses that go beyond physical damage, learning disruption, psychosocial stress, interrupted teaching, and limited institutional capacity for climate-responsive recovery. To maximize the utility of this investment, this proposal seeks an additional layer of work to translate data into costed, actionable plans for climate-resilient education recovery, ensuring affected communities are not left behind and development partners have a ready framework to support rapid response in line with the priority areas of Post Disaster Needs Assessment (PDNA).
